outcome: Registers and Actions tabs read the live sectioned project tab
acceptance_criteria: Registers on the mock read the live endpoint: opening `/projects/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101/registers` (and `/projects/P-0101/registers`) makes `GET /api/v1/projects/<uuid>/registers` with no `limit`, `register`, `cursor`, `state`, `owner` or `severity`; the page shows a "Register" tab list `Issues, Changes, Emergencies, RFPs` — verify: Playwright request log in `e2e/project-tabs.spec.ts` and the tab names at 1440 and 390.

The register switch has no count badges and there is no count text beside the search; Actions has no "N ACTIONS · N OVERDUE · N WITHOUT OWNER" line — verify: page at P-0101, text absent; a test asserts no digit-only badge on the register tabs.

An Issues row shows reference (mono), the issue title, severity, owner and state exactly as returned; a "Critical" row shows a neutral tag reading "Critical" (not High); there is no AGE column and no row link — verify: P-0101 registers page and `tests/project-tabs.test.tsx`.

Changes shows reference, module and "Version N"; Emergencies and RFPs show "—" for severity and owner; a null owner on an Issues row reads "Owner needed" — verify: switch registers on P-0101; `?register=changes` in the URL; unit test on the row text.

A person whose response has no Issues section sees only the registers returned and `?register=issues` falls back to the first available; with none of the four returned the page shows "No access to this tab" — verify: the variant fixture and a unit test with `sections: []`.
The Escalations section is never drawn, and no section title outside the mapping table appears anywhere — verify: P-0101 fixture has an Escalations row whose reference text is not on the page.

Paging on P-0102 (Issues 30 rows): the first read shows 25 Issues and a "Show more" button; pressing it requests `?page=2`, appends 5 rows (30 shown), and the button goes; switching to Changes afterwards shows its 1 row once, not twice (the clamped answer is not appended again) — verify: `tests/project-tabs.test.tsx` with the mock and the request log.
With a search, changing register does not request again, but changing the search does, from page 1, and drops the rows held — verify: request log; URL `?q=android` and `?register=changes&q=android`.
A failed "Show more" keeps every row, shows "We couldn’t load more. Your rows are safe; try again." with Retry, and Retry succeeds — verify: test forcing a 503 on `page=2`.

Actions: the section "Project actions" is shown with ACTION, OWNER, DUE, STATE; a null `due` shows the amber `Unknown` tag, not a date and not 0; `detail` "Owner needed" or null shows "Owner needed"; state tags show the live word in capitals with the tone table; no "From" line and no OVERDUE tag unless the live word is itself "Overdue" (it is then neutral) — verify: P-0101 actions page at 1440 and 390.
A due date-time shows as "13 Nov" in the Africa/Lagos test timezone — verify: unit test of `dueText` and the e2e run (`timezoneId: 'Africa/Lagos'`).

Negative: `P-0099` and a case outside the persona show the same "No access to this tab" state with no row text; `P-0103` (403) the same; a 401 shows the signed-out state with the tab's path kept; a 422 or 503 shows the error card with Try again and nothing was changed — verify: mock cases in `tests/project-tabs.test.tsx`.
A 200 whose `tab` is not the requested one, or whose sections are malformed, is shown as the error card, not as an empty list — verify: unit test of `isSectionsBody` and a hook test.
Search with no match shows "No <word> match “q”." with Clear search; a section with zero rows and no search shows "No <word> on this project yet." — verify: `?q=zzz` on P-0101; `P-0106`.

Mock contract: every served body for registers and actions (all personas, `P-0101`, `P-0102`, `P-0106`, UUID and `P-nnnn` ids, `page=1..3`, `q`) validates against the live 200 schema with Ajv (`strict: true`, `ajv-formats`), `case_id` is a UUID, page 3 of P-0102 answers each section's last page with its own `page`, `page=0` / `page=x` / `q=` answer 422 — verify: new `tests/mock-live-project-sections.test.ts` (pattern of `tests/mock-live-projects.test.ts`), run `npx vitest run tests/mock-live-project-sections.test.ts`.

`mergePage` and `isSectionsBody`, `parseSectionView`, `sectionSearch`, `stateTone`, `severityTag`, `dueText` have unit tests, including the clamp case and the duplicate case — verify: `tests/project-sections-model.test.ts`.

A grep of the two tab files and the new hook finds no `api.GET` and no import of the v7 `E-PROJECT-TAB` types — verify: `grep -rn "E-PROJECT-TAB\|useProjectTab" src/features/projects/RegistersTab.tsx src/features/projects/ActionsTab.tsx` returns nothing.

Against the real backend (Django 8010): signed in as `live-lead`, `/projects/<case_id>/registers` and `/actions` render without console errors and the as-of time shows; a case the account cannot read shows "No access to this tab" — verify: manual run with the lane ports, recorded in build.md.

Accessibility and layout: axe WCAG 2.2 AA clean and no horizontal scroll at 390 and 1440 on both tabs; the register switch keeps arrow, Home and End keys; after "Show more" removes the button, focus moves to the first new row — verify: `e2e/project-tabs.spec.ts` (registers and actions cases updated).

risk.rationale: Medium. It is read-only and touches no money, identity or data migration. It is a cross-layer contract change: the typed v7 arrays become display-text sections with a different paging model, and the tab model and tag mapping are rewritten (`tabsModel.ts`, `useProjectTab.ts`, `STATE_TAGS`). The main hazards are matching sections by `title` text (B-12), showing unknown values as 0 or as an invented status, and the shared-page behaviour across sections. Product acceptance is required because the client sees dropped counts, age and meeting origin, and a changed register switch (D-182, D-184). Surfaces are ui, api and contract-change. Security and auth are not in scope: the live API filters sections and tabs by permission, and the UI only renders what it receives.
